items.text: Today, I woke up to find Stephen Hubbard had posted an article about LeBron James' new venture. It was a perfect day for introspection, so I decided to start my morning jog around the neighborhood park. As I ran past the grownups playing chess and feeding pigeons, I couldn't help but feel like this adult world was far from where I wanted to be. Instead, I looked forward to the day when I could return to the simple joys of childhood, much like LeBron's young fans do with him. I realized that sometimes being a 'grownup' meant taking time for myself and appreciating the beauty in things that are often overlooked.

It was refreshing to see such creativity and collaboration among the young minds at our school.
